native_ram_validation: 10000 stereo frames across all modes, compact dry history, RAM banking/wrap and clear; unmodified supplier ram_infer via the project adapter.
effect_model_validation: 50000 stereo frames exact against the release independent fixed-point model.

B_KEY2.short_release: Cycle F0 -> F1 -> F2 -> F3 -> F4 -> F0

modes.F0: Original, fixed 1183-sample effect delay plus 32-sample repair delay

controls.B_display: Last digit shows selected effect 0..4 when no diagnostic error is displayed.

volume.arithmetic: Release gain factors and saturation, quantized to the existing 16-bit PCM SPI payload.

controls.wiring: No inter-board wiring change. B KEY2 is the on-board button at B2. A retains HDMI/touchscreen.
controls.preserved: Existing A KEY2/KEY3, waveform/spectrum, 11 transitions, dwell ripples, trophy/spotlights, audio repair and typed page cues.
controls.integration_scope: Port the release pitch/harmony algorithm and gain table into the full dual-board project; retain its existing display UI rather than the experimental single-board UI.
controls.audio_latency: Fixed dry-mode DSP delay 1215 samples (25.3125 ms) plus the existing A/SPI queues and up to 256 new completed frames; this is not a measured end-to-end latency.
controls.limitations: Time-domain experimental pitch algorithm; low bass/complex music can retain grain. No new hardware measurements.

architecture.processor: B: repair -> pitch -> 256-frame completed queue -> existing typed cue mixer -> boosted saturating volume -> SPI -> A HDMI
architecture.history: 4096 filtered stereo frames plus 2048 raw stereo frames for the fixed 1152-frame dry delay; six RAM32K blocks. Save 8 KiB without changing any accessed samples.
architecture.media_control_retiming: Latch the post-edge 512-byte sector predicate at input_end; all cycle-visible DLT outputs are compared against frozen 5.3 with full accepted media and malformed/overlapping boundaries.
architecture.producer_clear: Uses actual media stream-reset, track flush, abort and background-off; volume-only updates retain effect history.

firmware_packaging_note: Historical or duplicate firmware omitted; only the current A/B pair is delivered in the project releases directory.
